cards.subtitle: Deterministic Christiaan Huygens (1678) wavefront propagation & Heinrich Bruns (1895) Eikonal gradient normalization (d_Huygens(x) = f(x) / ||grad f(x)||, enforcing ||grad d|| = 1 so morphological dilation d(x) - r = 0 produces uniform Euclidean shell thickness W/r = 1.0000x across all 17 slope-dilution stations u in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 distorted stations) versus naive unnormalized algebraic level-set offsetting (f(x) - r = 0, which inflates Euclidean shell thickness as r / ||grad f|| = r*(1 + u) to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-step Eikonal PDE relaxation.
